page.layout: One page of text in two columns: a list of names in the centre, with the years in the left margin, and marginal notes in the right margin. Printed page number at the head.

main_text.l: 1564Pacta conventa inter partes intercessore Philippo C. [?] Caesare, de iure stapulæ.Sasscher van Heringa,
1567Praesidium militum in urbem [?] Groton, inductum.Johan Clant.

1568Com. Arembergius cum Hispanis suis caesus ad coenobium Hilligerlaum a Ludovico Com. Nassau, Groningam ab eodem obsessa, sed adventu Albani liberata; exercitus ipsius Iemgumi concisus.Ioachim Ubbena,

page.notes: The years 1562 to 1568 and the right-margin notes are set beside the column; the years and notes are placed at the line where they stand. The printed "15" for the year beside the Wiferinge block is cut off at the margin and shows only "1" and "5"; I wrote it as 15[?]. The right-margin note on the Pacta conventa line reads "EELIO" in the scan, probably the end of a word such as Caesare, which I marked [?]. The note on Groton is damaged and "urbem" and "Groton" are doubtful. The note on Arembergius is set in small type and partly blurred; "Iemgumi" and "Hilligerlaum" are as far as I could read them. The printed lines are set in italic and roman type mixed; I did not mark italics in the name lines since the name type is not clearly italic throughout. Its letters are not checked against a second reading.
